newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's NCB business basically stable - MOF minister.
newsitem.headline: Japan's NCB business basically stable - MOF minister.

text.p: The business and management foundations of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) remain firm, supported by the bank's efforts to restructure its business and to deal with problem loans, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a key parliamentary committee on Wednesday.
Mitsuzuka said he had received reports that the bank was doing its utmost to restructure its businesses to dispose of problem loans.
"The foundation (of the bank) is not in the least shaken," Mitsuzuka said.
